Legal

Privacy policy

Plainly stated, updated October 2026.

What this site does not do

  • No accounts, logins, or membership records on this website.
  • No hidden analytics, ad trackers or fingerprinting scripts.
  • No data sold, shared or cross-tracked to third parties.

Forms on this site

Our contact and join-us forms are currently frontend placeholders. They do not transmit or store anything on this website — when you submit one, it composes a message in your own email app for you to review and send to enactusarsdchapter@gmail.com. Your name, email address and message go to the chapter only if you send that email.

Email correspondence

If you email the chapter, your message is seen by the core team to respond to your enquiry. Messages are kept no longer than needed to handle the follow-up. Ask us by email if you would like correspondence removed.

External links

The site links to Instagram, LinkedIn and our Linktree. These platforms (not this website) apply their own privacy practices and handle accounts you choose to follow from here.

Cookies

This website sets no tracking or analytics cookies of its own. Browser settings or platform-level infrastructure (such as hosting) may retain standard technical logs, governed by the hosting provider.

Changes & contact

This policy is updated alongside site features — most recently October 2026. Questions about privacy: enactusarsdchapter@gmail.com.
